name: Dr. Md. Arifur Rahman
designation: Cancer & Tumor Specialist, Registrar, Mymensingh Medical College & Hospital
feedback: The breast cancer AI system has been really helpful in my work. Having the lesions already segmented makes the findings much easier to review, and it also helps reduce the differences I sometimes see between readings.

name: Dr. Mahmud Hasan Mostofa Kamal
designation: Associate Professor, Department of Radiology and Imaging, Bangladesh Medical University
feedback: Working with Big-Matrix Solutions has felt more like a real collaboration than a typical vendor relationship. Their team takes the time to understand how our radiologists actually work before suggesting or building a solution. I really appreciate that approach.

name: Dr. Mohammad Monir Uddin
feedback: Scriptor has made my research workflow much simpler. I can work on a paper in LaTeX, prepare a presentation from the same project, and review PDFs without constantly switching between different tools. It has also made it much easier to keep track of what projects I'm working on.

name: Dr. Sheikh Anisul Haque
designation: Associate Consultant, Bangladesh Specialized Hospital, Dhaka
feedback: RxCloud has made it much easier to manage prescriptions across my chambers. My assistant can prepare everything for me, and I can review and approve it before anything is sent out. It gives me better control over the process and helps make sure nothing goes out without my approval.
